motions.name: Vocals Loop
motions.observation: Vocals performance with the existing held prop.
motions.interpretation: The singer shifts weight, turns and lifts the head with each phrase and gestures from the elbow with the free hand; the microphone stays at the lips as the head moves.

motions.name: Pipes Loop
motions.observation: Corrected playing hold for the existing panpipes model.
motions.interpretation: The pipes slide under the lips from note to note and rest on each one, with a breath between phrases; the head leads each slide and both hands stay with the mouth.

motions.name: Tambourine Loop
motions.observation: Raised rim hold with deliberate free-hand taps and small wrist shakes.
motions.interpretation: The drum is held in front of the chest with its face outward and its ribbons down; the free palm draws back, strikes and bounces off the skin on the beat while the knees, head and a tapping heel keep time, and the wrist shakes the jingles between strikes.
